parity_reason: Both images score 22 in total and get the same score on every criterion, so no criterion differs by more than 1. Neither image has a critical defect, so all three parity conditions hold.

reference.summary: A cartoon brown monkey clings to the trunk of an apple tree full of red apples and reaches up toward the canopy, with a sky, sun, clouds and grass behind; it answers the prompt well.

defects.what: The lower body reads as a shapeless curled blob, and the single visible foot hangs loosely in front of the trunk instead of gripping it.
defects.expected: Clearly drawn legs whose feet press against or wrap around the trunk, so the climbing grip is believable.

defects.what: Thin dark lines on the trunk cross behind and beside the monkey's body and look like stray strokes rather than bark or vines.
defects.expected: Bark detail that clearly belongs to the trunk and does not tangle with the monkey's outline.

defects.what: The raised hand floats just under an apple without clearly holding a branch or the fruit.
defects.where: the monkey's raised arm at the bottom edge of the canopy
defects.expected: The raised hand visibly grips a branch or holds an apple.

defects.what: The large canopy dominates the frame and the monkey sits fairly low, so the eye goes to the foliage first.
defects.expected: The monkey stands out as the clear focal point, with the canopy supporting it.

attempt.summary: A cartoon brown monkey hangs from two branches of an apple tree, its body against the trunk and one leg bent, under a sun in a clear sky; it answers the prompt well.

defects.what: Only one leg is visible, and it is kicked out to the side with the foot in mid-air instead of bracing on the trunk.
defects.expected: Two legs, with feet gripping or pushing against the trunk in a climbing pose.

defects.what: The ground is a thin flat sliver at the very bottom, so the tree base looks barely planted.
defects.expected: The tree's base sits clearly in a visible patch of ground.

defects.what: The lower half of the frame is mostly empty trunk and sky, which leaves the image top-heavy.
defects.expected: A more balanced layout where the space below the monkey is not left empty.

defects.what: The flat dark green canopy makes the overlapping foliage circles merge, and some apples blend into the dense shape.
defects.expected: Foliage with enough tonal variation to separate the leaf clusters and make the apples stand out.
